name: KIC 5035683
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.5 solar radii and 1.49 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5035683 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.5307 +/- 0.2145

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5035683 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.4858 +/- 0.0613

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5035683 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4630.7334 +/- 41.6774

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5035683 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.489 +/- 0.004

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.49 solar masses and 11.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,631 K at its surface.
